learnings: In `MoxfieldDeckInfoScraper.ScrapeDeckList`: when `maxCost` is null, uses existing concurrent `Task.WhenAll` with `Take(count)`; when provided, iterates sequentially via the semaphore and collects decks where `price <= maxCost` until `count` results are gathered.

Applied identical branching logic to `ArchidektDeckInfoScraper.ScrapeDeckList`: null path retains concurrent scraping with null-filtering; non-null path loops sequentially, skips failed scrapes, and filters by price.
